heuristic.applicability: Prefer for a securely held source when the current intermediate state is uncertain in phase: particles may have discharged earlier or later than nominal, the policy is entered mid-tilt or mid-righting, or a small execution deviation should be corrected from the fresh TCP. Reliable particle, bowl, container and TCP observations are required. Do not use particle motion alone as proof of contact or grasp.

handoff.entry_conditions: The source is securely closed in the gripper and clear of support. Entry may be in early carry, at the staged pose, during the tilt/discharge arc, or during righting if the observed relational state remains within demonstrated nominal phases and the next local motion is reachable.
handoff.exit_conditions: Observed particle geometry indicates at least ten particles settled in the bowl; the source is approximately upright, remains held, and is beginning outbound motion. The unchanged success and successor conditions are not replaced by the learned phase auxiliary.
handoff.failure_signatures: Uncertain/open grasp, large relocation beyond local residual support, particle observations that are missing or implausible, particles outside bowl bounds, collision or spill, non-converged IK, or oscillation between tilt and righting. Successful nominal data do not establish recovery from these failures.
handoff.overlap_role: All [180,360) incoming and [1460,1740) outgoing actions remain supervised. This permits the phase-aware model to continue from grasp_lift_stage and to overlap return_place_release throughout late righting and early outbound carry.
handoff.successor_readiness: Hand off to return_place_release only when observed particle settlement and source uprightness support it. Nominal readiness is near 1680, with supervised flexibility across 1460-1740.

heuristic.limitations: The local residual representation is not structurally anchored to a far-away bowl, so large bowl relocations or long open-loop errors should use the bowl-frame prior. The set encoder can distinguish observed geometric phases but cannot infer hidden contact truth or guarantee that a particle is inside the source under severe occlusion/noise. The auxiliary current-phase labels regularize representation learning; they do not change success or authorize early handoff. Demonstrations contain no spill or slip recovery.
heuristic.pipeline_implications: Use this as the phase/intermediate-state specialist. Its fresh-TCP residual decoder should reduce sensitivity to small state deviations, while the pooled particle encoder and phase auxiliary expose discharge progress without particle identity. Route major bowl displacement to the bowl-frame prior and route an unusual rigid grasp transform to the source-motion prior.
heuristic.rationale: The demonstrated discharge timing varies despite similar arm motion. In demo12300 at 800 several particles are still airborne or near the source while some are settled; in demo12303 at 800 all twelve are already on the bowl floor. By 900-1100 both runs show settled particles while the arm reaches and leaves maximum tilt. A flat identity-sensitive particle vector and world action can make tilt/right phase ambiguous. A shared per-particle encoder with symmetric mean/max pooling is invariant to particle ordering, and explicit bowl-relative and source-relative particle geometry exposes settlement and remaining-source evidence. A small auxiliary head predicts current settled fraction, source fraction and source uprightness from the same causal condition, with a masked MSE gradient through the set encoder. Local TCP-frame translation and rotation-vector actions are decoded from each fresh measured TCP, targeting small execution deviations. The standard diffusion U-Net remains unchanged after the condition encoder.
heuristic.statement: Permutation-invariant particle-phase prior with fresh-TCP residual actions: encode unordered relational particle tokens and causal robot/source context, regularize the shared condition with current phase labels, and diffuse local TCP-frame SE(3) displacements plus the gripper command.

assignment.subgoal: With the source continuously held, finish transport to a high bowl-centered pose, tilt it in the demonstrated controlled arc until at least ten of twelve particles are transferred into the bowl, then rotate it back toward upright and start moving away. Keep the gripper closed and the container above the bowl walls throughout. Approximate entry: securely grasped source, from early lift-off through staged upright pose. Approximate exit: emptied source approximately upright, still grasped, elevated and approaching the return region.

check.checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: Recompose each local label from its corresponding measured pre-action TCP pose, solve IK from measured joints and compare FK target position, rotation and gripper scalar with the demonstrated commanded target.

contract.cut_relation: Every assigned action [180,1740) in all twelve trajectories remains supervised. The particle encoder and current-TCP residual representation preserve incoming [180,360) and outgoing [1460,1740) overlaps rather than creating a phase-only recut.
contract.output_semantics: Each slot is [translation xyz in metres in the current TCP frame, local rotation vector xyz in radians, native gripper scalar]. Training uses inverse(T_world_tcp_before_action) times T_world_commanded_tcp. Execution composes the represented local transform with the fresh observed TCP pose, then panda_kinematics.solve_ik uses fresh measured joints. Slots represent t-1 through t+14; execution uses slots 1 through 8.
contract.parameter_semantics: No caller parameters. Two causal observations provide measured robot state, source/bowl/TCP/goal poses and twelve world particle positions. Particle identity is intentionally removed by symmetric learned pooling.
